attributes.name: Horsechopper +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to roll your Strength or Melee die + 1d10+1. If you are proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

If you fail a combat check using this weapon, you may discard this card to ignore the result and reroll the dice. You must take the second result.
